body:
The latest published packages are installed on the public sites, but feature coverage is not uniform. Complete route-by-route adoption without changing each site’s look and feel. Keep essential work offline and preserve source formatting, validation, undo/redo and last-valid-preview behavior.

- [ ] Verify openpresentation.org `/` and `/playground` as the accepted baseline: editable JSON, live preview in both directions, contextual options and normal code-editor behavior.
- [ ] Integrate appropriate interactive OPF examples and preview/editor links into pptx.gallery cards and detail pages. `/opf-editor/index.html` already uses the current bundled editor; package adoption alone does not make all gallery previews interactive.
- [ ] Add shared `@openpresentation/opf-editor/json-options` categorical choices to pptx.dev `/author`’s existing Monaco editor using loaded catalog/gallery and document context.
- [ ] Add preview-to-JSON editing to pptx.dev `/playground` and `/inspector` through the shared editor session. Today `PlaygroundShell → PreviewPane → SlideCanvas` only calls `renderSvg` and has no edit callback.
- [ ] Add appropriate interactive JSON/slide examples to docs and update stale public package/API guidance. Audit `pptx-dev/docs/browser-opf-workflow.md`, which still names core0.8/render-PPTX0.6/editor0.5 while manifests use core0.10/render-PPTX0.8/editor0.7.
- [ ] Verify actual published routes and complete user flows after deployment, recording the package graph separately from feature coverage. Ship focused commits and reviewed PRs.

Initial findings came from a read-only source audit; recheck live routes before claiming completion. This work follows the current PR consolidation and is separate from unpublished shaping and [PowerPoint compatibility acceptance](https://github.com/OpenPresentation/opf/issues/87).

Production evidence (2026-09-17). **Not closing this issue** — the checklist is not fully satisfied (homepage `/` baseline re-verify, docs/stale API audit including `pptx-dev/docs/browser-opf-workflow.md`, overlay vs stacked-SVG hit testing).

| Header & footer playground example | https://www.openpresentation.org/playground | `ea0d0321a20856ed110ab43acc20cd231378d604` ([openpresentation-site#39](https://github.com/Data-Advantage/openpresentation-site/pull/39)) | `dpl_GqqrJyxmwT5JCeQY3m9Tw2SDRN5R` (`www.openpresentation.org`) |

Handoff/matrix update recording this (draft, not a close): [opf#93](https://github.com/OpenPresentation/opf/pull/93) HEAD `951e7b8e8f8b0ce3b0ebfd5c7578018e8da9f599`.

Still not this issue: native Office `p:hf` ([#87](https://github.com/OpenPresentation/opf/issues/87)); renderer 0.1px ([opf-render#24](https://github.com/OpenPresentation/opf-render/issues/24)); geometry drafts; homepage-renderer.
